cli.usage:
usage: templartorrent [--font FILE] [--geoip-db FILE] [--allow-local-trackers]
                      [--allow-local-urls] [--] [MAGNET | FILE.torrent | URL]...

       templartorrent --register | --unregister        (Windows)

A second launch forwards each magnet, .torrent path or http(s) URL to the
running instance and exits. The running instance opens the Add dialog; it does
not start a transfer until Add is confirmed.

URL downloads refuse loopback, private, link-local and other local addresses
unless --allow-local-urls (or the matching setting) is on, as
--allow-local-trackers does for tracker URLs.

Peer countries and flags come from the bundled DB-IP Country Lite database
(IP Geolocation by DB-IP, CC BY 4.0), looked up offline. --geoip-db FILE,
$TEMPLARTORRENT_GEOIP_DB, or GeoLite2-Country.mmdb in the data directory
replaces it.

Jobs, limits and peer preferences are saved under
$XDG_DATA_HOME/templartorrent/session (default ~/.local/share; on Windows
%LOCALAPPDATA%/templartorrent/session) and restored on the next launch after
a disk recheck. Removing a job deletes its record.

On Windows, --register makes this executable available as the handler for
magnet links and .torrent files for the current user (no administrator
rights) and opens Settings so it can be chosen as the default; --unregister
removes only the entries that still point at templartorrent.exe.
